title: Keep private keys out of client bundles
prompt: An application puts a private LLM API key in NEXT_PUBLIC_LLM_KEY and VITE_LLM_KEY. Explain the exposure and an appropriate remediation. Respond in a few concise lines; do not modify files.
rubric: The answer treats both client-exposed prefixes and browser bundles as public.
It moves private credentials to the backend, restricts access through authorized server operations, and rotates an exposed key.
acceptance: The response satisfies the listed behavioral requirements and makes no changes.
